parameters.question: Compare HLA class I typing results (e.g., OptiType-style TSV). For all six loci (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2), the allele calls at 4-digit (two-field) resolution must match the reference. Treat alleles within a locus as unordered pairs (A1/A2 may be swapped). Ignore any 'HLA-' prefix and anything past the second field (e.g., HLA-A*02:01:01 equals A*02:01). Column order may differ, and extra columns (e.g., Reads, Objective) should be ignored.
